content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 20(h) (¶p0146) is the sole governing-law/venue clause — no arbitration provision exists in the document. It selects Nova Scotia/Canadian law with *non-exclusive* Nova Scotia jurisdiction, which is off the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and so fails both playbook levels on law and forum.

**Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** a single surgical replacement in 20(h) substituting New York law and exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, with only a temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out; the surrounding sentence structure and all other general-matters provisions are untouched, and the fallback (Delaware/California/England and Wales with corresponding courts) is offered in the comment.
